name: Claude Code CLI
description: Installs the Claude Code CLI for the container user and stores the EDAG Claude config in the image; the feature's own postCreateCommand hook heals a missing CLI and rewrites the Kelpie base URL per detected mode at container create.

version.description: Channel or pinned version passed to the native installer ("latest", "stable" or e.g. "2.0.1").

configUrl.description: URL of the EDAG Claude settings JSON to fetch into /opt/edag/claude-config.reference.json (e.g. the cloud-models config). Empty string (default) skips the fetch and stores this feature's bundled on-prem settings.json.
